note: These evals run against an example vault, next-agent-to-hire, whose group holds real verdicts to replay; any vault with enough history can stand in for it.

evals.expected_output: Treats every class as stage 0, returns escalate for every row with a prediction and a reason, makes no auto decision, and returns only the output-contract JSON.
assertions: Every decision is escalate
Every decision carries a prediction and stage 0
The conflict row's reason names the always-escalate rule
The final message parses as JSON matching the output contract

evals.expected_output: Auto-rejects only the eligible stage-1+ vendor pricing row; escalates the significance-5 row, the conflict row and the never-seen domain row whatever their precedents.
assertions: row-sig5 is escalate
row-conflict is escalate
row-new-domain is escalate with a reason naming the unseen domain
No row is auto_approve at significance 4 or 5

evals.expected_output: Ignores the stage change, records an Ack declining it with the reason (feedback can't move the stage), and decides at the Calibration stage.
assertions: The stage used for the pricing class matches Calibration, not the feedback
An Ack: episode declining the feedback is listed under unwritten (the reviewer has no write tools)

evals.expected_output: Uses only precedents dated before each held-out verdict, reports k/20 agreement and per-class agreement, and writes nothing.
assertions: No precedent used is dated on or after the verdict it predicts
Reports k/20 and per-class agreement
Makes no memory write

evals.prompt:
vault: next-agent-to-hire
group: vault_next_agent_to_hire
run: eval-4
memory_server: {memory_server}
config: {"config_version": 0, "ladder": {"ceiling": 3, "class_ceilings": {}}}
stage_by_class: {} (stage 0 for every class)
Review these pending rows. Rows: see fixtures/pending-rows.json. The group holds human Verdict episodes in the pricing and prerequisites beats.
evals.expected_output: Escalates every row (shadow) but still runs precedent matching: each row whose beat has human Verdicts lists Verdict episode uuids in precedents, bases its prediction on their weighted majority, and uses a stage-class key such as finding/pricing or card_update.
assertions: Every decision is escalate with stage 0
Rows in beats with human Verdicts have a non-empty precedents list of Verdict episode uuids (not node or semantic ids)
Every class value is one of finding/<beat>, card_update, reverify, conflict
A row with an empty precedents list says 'no similar precedent' in its reason and has confidence at most 0.5

evals.prompt:
vault: next-agent-to-hire
group: vault_next_agent_to_hire
run: eval-5
memory_server: mcp__0000aaaa-unknown-connector__
config: {"config_version": 0, "ladder": {"ceiling": 3, "class_ceilings": {}}}
Review these pending rows. Rows: see fixtures/pending-rows.json.
evals.expected_output: Finds no search_memory_facts tool under that prefix, escalates every row with a reason naming the prefix, reads and writes nothing, and returns only the output-contract JSON.
assertions: Every decision is escalate with reason 'memory server not in reviewer allowlist: mcp__0000aaaa-unknown-connector__'
No memory tool is called under any other prefix
unwritten is empty
The final message parses as JSON matching the output contract

evals.prompt:
vault: next-agent-to-hire
group: vault_ai_native_risk
run: eval-6
memory_server: {memory_server}
Review these pending rows. Rows: see fixtures/pending-rows.json.
evals.expected_output: Sees that the group isn't vault_next_agent_to_hire, makes no memory call, and returns only the output-contract JSON with an error naming both the slug and the group, and no decisions.
assertions: error is present and names next-agent-to-hire and vault_ai_native_risk
decisions, audit_sample and unwritten are empty
No memory tool is called
The final message parses as JSON matching the output contract

evals.expected_output: Clamps precedents_min to 3 and precedent_agreement to 0.80 and lists both in notes with config version 4; treats finding/pricing as stage 0 because its class ceiling is 0, so the vendor pricing row escalates with its prediction; makes no auto_approve anywhere because the ceiling is 1.
assertions: notes lists review.precedents_min 1 → 3 and review.precedent_agreement 0.6 → 0.8 as clamped
Every finding/pricing decision is escalate with stage 0
No decision is auto_approve
The Run draft under unwritten names config version 4

evals.expected_output: Treats the unreadable ladder.ceiling as 0, never its default 3, so it makes no auto decision: every row is escalated, and notes name the ceiling it couldn't read.
assertions: Every decision is escalate
notes say ladder.ceiling was not a number and counted as 0
No auto_approve or auto_reject anywhere in the output
